svg.title: Study 3601: vomiting outcomes, placebo vs tradipitant
svg.desc: Study 3601: vomiting outcomes, placebo vs tradipitant. Any vomiting (primary): placebo 58.5%, tradipitant 43.0%, p=0.006. Vomiting + worst nausea 3 or more (key secondary): placebo 50.6%, tradipitant 33.1%, p=0.002. Frequent multi-day vomiting (post hoc): placebo 15.9%, tradipitant 6.3%, p=0.008. Extreme vomiting, >10 episodes (post hoc): placebo 14.6%, tradipitant 2.8%, p=0.0003.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
